coverage: Four predictive horizons independent from future events/frames/final totals/outcome
Zero versus missing, malformed assistants, environmental kills, unsupported versions, overflow, event identity conflicts, foreign-match rejection
Distinct row/match/player counts, common filters and exclusion versus missing-value counts
Atomic worker publication, same processing provenance, two idempotent offline rebuilds and removed-definition replacement
Rollback after dataset materialization preserves raw and recovery state
Database temporal/finiteness CHECKs and cascade deletion
Byte-identical exports, whole-match temporal split, separate features/labels/descriptive files and captured lineage
limitations: Single real patch/queue/map; synthetic copies do not establish population representativeness or production throughput. Export cap100000 rows is explicit and rejects partial publication.
